Politically a coalition between PVV (Wilders), VVD (Conservative classic liberals) and CDA (Christian Democrats) has a precedent in the so-called gedoogkabinet (a minority cabinet with agreed support of other parties): the First Rutte Cabinet (VVD + CDA with support from PVV, who had no ministers in the Cabinet) although both VVD and CDA have issued statements that they won't form a coalition with Wilders. Which might be mere rhetoric, but even if they would, a PPV+VVD+CDA coalition wouldn't have a majority.
